title: 2020 South West Aviation Antonov An-26 crash
summary: South West Aviation An-26 freighter EX-126 crashed during takeoff from Juba Airport on a cargo charter flight to Wau. Eyewitnesses reported the aircraft suddenly lost power shortly after departure. The aircraft lost height and impacted a farm in the Hai Referendum residential area 2.5 nautical miles from the runway. Eight occupants were killed including Russian crew and South Sudanese personnel. The investigation determined the aircraft lacked valid airworthiness and operator certificates but could not establish the cause.
